name: Sentinel Path A — Real Estate Photos

nodes.name: Execute Sub Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by Package Router. Receives: { mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path, processing_job_id, source_platform, address, city }

nodes.name: Execute Color Grade
nodes.notes: Runs video_color_grade.py. For photo-only missions, script exits 0 with 'No video files found -- skipped'. The script self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter.

nodes.name: Parse Color Grade Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_color_grade.py. Passes through all trigger parameters for next step.

nodes.name: Stop on Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This just stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute Delivery Packaging
nodes.notes: Runs delivery_packaging.py with --photos-only for real estate packages. Uses --address and --city from drone_jobs Supabase lookup (done in Package Router). Script self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter.

_meta.description: Path A sub-workflow for real estate photo processing. Runs color grading (graceful no-op for photo-only missions) then delivery packaging with --photos-only. Each step self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter. Called by Package Router Execute Sub Workflow node.

parameters_expected.folder_path: Full path to mission folder on disk
parameters_expected.processing_job_id: UUID of the processing_jobs row for status reporting
